findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The inspectors observed the caulking on the hand sink next to the prep station in a state of disrepair. PIC was notified. PIC and assured inspectors that sink will be caulked to the wall. Ensure that sink is repaired appropriately.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: There was no sanitizer bucket available on the cook line during food prep upon arrival. PIC was made aware about the availability of a sanitizer bucket during food prep and a sani bucket was made. Ensure that there is a sanitizer bucket available at all time during food prep.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(E) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (E) If a chemical SANITIZER other than chlorine, iodine, or a quaternary ammonium compound is used, it shall be applied in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There is observed slight soil accumulation underneath kitchen equipment and along the front of equipment in the kitchen and along the surfaces of various locations. Ensure that cleaning takes place to clean the current accumulation and then at a frequency necessary to maintain these surfaces clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment: 410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-102.11: There is observed two spray bottles containing QUAT sanitizer that were unlabeled in the facility. A label was printed for these bottles during the inspection and placed with the common name onto the bottles. Ensure that once a product, such as a sanitizer, is added to an unlabeled container that a label containing the common name of the product is added to the container for identification purposes. 
7-102.11: Working containers used for storing POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS such as cleaners and SANITIZERS taken from bulk supplies shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following equipment is observed to have an accumulation of food residues and will need to be cleaned and sanitized:
-The shelf underneath the pizza boxes on the prep table has an accumulation of food debris.
-The gasket and inside door frame of the walk-in cooler is observed to have sauce present on its surface. 
-The top of the magnetic knife strip is osberved to have an accumulation of food residues.
Ensure these locations are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There is observed food residue accumulating under the storage shelving and along the walls of the store room. There is specifically food residues accumulating under the green storage shelf that is adjacent to the silver prep table leading to the office area. Ensure the physical facilities, with attention to the underneath of equipment, are cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
